sloka: श्रुत्वैव तु वचो मह्यं क्षिप्रमेष्यति राघवः ।चमूं प्रकर्षन् महतीं हर्यृक्षगणसङ्कुलाम् ।। ५.३६.३४।।।।
transliteration: śrutvaiva tu vaco mahyaṁ kṣiprameṣyati rāghavaḥ ।camūṁ prakarṣan mahatīṁ haryṛkṣagaṇasaṅkulām ।। 5.36.34।।।।

translations.english: "As soon as he hears your words from me, Rama will reach (here), leading a huge army of powerful troops of vanaras and bears.
